purpose: The single registry of published numbers. Every value here must be reproducible from the named artefact, and every `readme` token must appear in README.md. `aerosphinx check-claims` enforces both.
protocol_notes: Track A and Track B are separate experiments on separate eligible-date sets and must never be quoted interchangeably.

The canonical Track A comparison is the M0-M8 matrix (97 folds, 2,615 matched predictions, one eligible set shared by every configuration). scripts/run_track_a.py is a protocol-discovery tool with a narrower eligible set (2,510 predictions, rows requiring a complete 7-day warm-up) and its ridge delta has the opposite sign; it is not the published Track A result.
The legacy single-window evaluation (33 test days, 2024-05-17 to 2024-06-18) is retained only as the reproducibility baseline for the book chapter and is labelled as such.
A Track B ablation is reported as a point estimate with a paired block-bootstrap interval and a Holm-adjusted p-value; none of them is significant at n=49.

Track A's ridge-vs-persistence pair is now part of the ablation family, so it carries the same day-level block bootstrap and the same year-blocked interval as every Track B pair. Day-level resampling excludes zero ([-1.14, -0.17]); year-blocked resampling does not ([-1.20, +0.06]). Both are reported.
